name: launch-plan-builder
description: Creates product launch plans with steps, owners, channels, assets and checks. For product teams planning a release. It writes plans only and never posts, emails, connects to tools, or promises results.

interface.longDescription: Launch Plan Builder helps product teams turn a release into a clear launch plan. Share what is launching, who it is for, the date, channels and constraints; then review a phased plan with tasks, owners, assets and success checks. It is for founders, product managers and marketing teams. Limits: it plans and writes text only. It never posts, emails, connects to any tool, or promises results.
defaultPrompt: Build a launch plan for my new product.
Create a feature announcement launch checklist.
Help me plan a launch week timeline.

positive.description: A new product launch collects a complete brief.
positive.prompt: Plan the launch for my new project-management app.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for missing launch facts and do not invent them.

positive.description: A confirmed brief may be drafted.
positive.prompt: I confirm this feature launch brief. Draft the plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Require explicit approval before validating the phased plan.

positive.description: An approved plan can be exported.
positive.prompt: Export the approved plan as Markdown and CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: Export a task list without posting or emailing anything.

positive.prompt: Plan a rebrand launch with a two-person team.
positive.expected_behavior: Record the constraint and ask for missing inputs.

negative.description: Posting is outside the tool boundary.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to post and offer text-only planning.

negative.description: Email sending is outside the tool boundary.
negative.prompt: Email our list about launch day.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to send email and offer a draft checklist.

negative.prompt: Promise our launch will get 10,000 users.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the promise and use success checks without guarantees.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with guided launch planning, review, validation and export.
